instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Application Scope: General Insurance Policy Document MIS System with automated OCR extraction, side-by-side human-in-the-loop verification, role-based permission access (Admin, Agent, Backoffice), and comprehensive Excel/CSV MIS reporting.
2. Role-Based Access Control matrix to implement:
- Admin: Full access to all modules, system-wide MIS download, user onboarding, credential generation, and branch mapping.
- Agent: Can upload policy docs, view real-time OCR results, edit limited personal fields, and download respective agent policy MIS.
- Backoffice: Full access to policy upload, OCR extraction, full manual correction & verification interface, and download assigned branch/team MIS.
3. Line of Business (LOB) Coverage in forms and OCR extractors:
- Motor: Vehicle Reg No, Chassis No, Engine No, Make/Model, Year, IDV, OD Premium, TP Premium, NCB %, Net Premium, GST (18%), Gross Premium.
- Health: Sum Insured, Plan Name, Deductible, Proposer Name, Insured Members (Age/Relation), Room Rent Cap, Co-pay, Net Premium, GST, Gross Premium.
- Fire / Marine / Commercial: Risk Location, Sum Insured Breakdown (Building, Plant & Machinery, Stock), Policy Period, Deductible, Terrorism Premium, Total Gross Premium.
- Provide sample pre-loaded realistic policy documents (Bajaj Allianz, HDFC ERGO, ICICI Lombard, Star Health, Tata AIG, New India Assurance).
- Provide simulated instant AI OCR extraction with visual field bounding boxes, confidence tags (e.g. 98% Green, 72% Amber), and one-click 'Copy OCR to Form'.
- Actions: 'Verify & Approve', 'Save Draft', 'Flag Discrepancy' (with reason dropdown + note), 'Re-extract OCR'.
- Export CSV and clean formatted Excel (.xlsx via backend/openpyxl or client-side generation) with all key policy columns, financial breakdown, and SLA metrics.

7. Data Testids: Ensure all interactive buttons, role switchers, table rows, filter dropdowns, and form inputs have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="login-role-admin"`, `data-testid="upload-dropzone"`, `data-testid="verify-approve-btn"`, `data-testid="export-mis-csv"`).
